bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_hstnv_9 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/common/ot_fwd_link_stage.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_station_native/gen18r/dsfd_hstnv_9.sv && echo lint-ok

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: f9 (S-ELEM ENGRAM-LKP 1815, 2026-10-16): MX misfit in c26l: the closed f1 view (17.256 x 17.256, 63.91 rows) fails orientation row_parity (codex0827 table: MX/R180 FAIL row_parity only), the die places it MX. Outline 17.256 x 16.74 = 62 rows of 0.27 um (even) so MX / R180 keep rail polarity (row_parity PASS) and the view stays inside the 17.256 x 17.256 generator slot; newest f8 recipe: no recipe-2 output hold pads (hop hold carried by the receiver's input hold stages), pins spread evenly per face (spread_face_pins.py, margin 2.16, clock at face centre) -- the die reads pins from the bound LEF. RTL = the generator --hstn-posedge emission (one posedge flop per bit, no reset), 0 cycles.
